name: akiflow
description: Connect to Akiflow through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Akiflow documents an official remote MCP with OAuth 2.1, available on all paid plans and during the free trial. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256. Akiflow's calendar tools read and RSVP on the person's connected Google or Outlook calendars, so that data reaches Kipster through Akiflow's cloud; kept because it is the person's own Akiflow account rather than an aggregator, and flagged as a third-party data flow.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
